question: In which country, the first Commonwealth Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first Commonwealth Games were held in **Hamilton, Canada**, from **August 16 to August 23, 1930**.
 
• The event was initially called the **British Empire Games** and later renamed to Commonwealth Games in 1950.
 
• A total of **11 nations** participated in the inaugural games, featuring **6 sports** and 59 events.
 
• The vision for the games was conceived by **Melville Marks Robinson**, a Canadian sports administrator.
 
• Hamilton, Canada, provided a $30,000 fund to cover travel expenses for competitors from participating countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games Overview**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is a **multi-sport international event** involving athletes from nations part of the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• It is held every **four years**, with participation limited to Commonwealth member countries.
 
• The games promote **friendship and cooperation** among member nations through sports.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of the Games**
 
 
• The name transitioned from the British Empire Games (1930–1950) to the British Empire and Commonwealth Games (1954–1966), the British Commonwealth Games (1970–1974), and finally the Commonwealth Games (from 1978).
 
• Women’s participation expanded significantly over time, making the games more inclusive.
 
 
 
• **Key Sports at the Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• Some popular sports include athletics, swimming, badminton, boxing, cycling, hockey, and weightlifting.
 
• Para-sports have been integrated into the games since the 2002 edition in Manchester.
 
 
 
• **Recent Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games were held in **Birmingham, England**.
 
• The games witnessed participation from **72 nations and territories**.
